integrity: Uniform proof from an explicit CW model, exact integer chain cancellation, elementary fundamental group, and homological Whitehead; no independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Homotopy types rather than homeomorphism types.
No classification of other group actions; finite script does not prove the infinite case.
Potential unindexed equivalent fixed-space literature remains.
title: Reflection-fixed spheres and zero persistence in finite subset spaces of the circle
